package: 5.08mm pitch THT screw terminal block, 1 row x 2 positions
description: Ningbo Kangnex Electric WJ500V-5.08-XXP-1Y-00A family, drawing shows the 2-position (2P) single-pitch variant used on this board. THT PCB screw terminal block: housing PA66 UL94V-0, screw M2.5 steel Zn-plated, cage contact copper alloy Ni-plated, pin (solder tail) copper alloy Sn-plated. Body per the vendor's own drawing dimensions: length along the pin row = N x 5.08mm = 10.16mm for N=2, depth 10.00mm, height above the PCB seating plane 14.07mm. Non-polarized, mechanically symmetric 2-pin part - used on this board as both J1 (VIN input, left edge) and J2 (5V output, right edge) per parts.json.

pinout.name: Terminal 1
pinout.notes: Generic screw-clamp wire terminal position. The datasheet assigns no polarity or function to either position (mechanically symmetric, non-polarized 2P block, no pin-1 marking on the drawing). Net function (VIN+/GND for J1, or +5V/GND for J2) is a schematic-level assignment, not a datasheet fact - see requirements.md/parts.json for the board-specific mapping.

pinout.name: Terminal 2
pinout.notes: Generic screw-clamp wire terminal position, same caveats as pin 1.

land_pattern.package: 5.08mm pitch, 2x round THT holes, single row
land_pattern.notes: From the vendor's 'PCB LAYOUT' view (the recommended-footprint drawing, distinct from the package-outline views above it): 2x round through-holes on 5.08mm pitch, single row. End margin from body edge to first hole center is 2.54mm (half pitch), consistent with the overall body length dimension N x 5.08mm = 10.16mm for this 2-pole part. The ONLY hole-size figure the drawing states is a 1.50mm dimension attached to a hole via a diagonal leader line in the PCB-layout view, read here as the DRILL diameter (standard convention for that leader style on this vendor's drawings) - the drawing gives no separate copper-pad/annular-ring diameter, so size the pad per house/fab minimum annular ring over this 1.50mm drill. The pins themselves are rectangular in cross-section, approx. 0.90mm x 0.80mm (0.90 called out in the front/pin view, 0.80 in the side view of the solder tail) rather than round, so the round drill must clear the pin's ~1.20mm diagonal - plausible given the 1.50mm drill. Two further dimensions appear on the drawing (3.14mm, vertical, in the PCB-layout view; 4.20mm, vertical, in the front/pin view) whose exact reference datum could not be pinned down with confidence from the rendered page - re-check the vendor drawing directly before finalizing the KiCad footprint (see OPEN).

layout_notes: PCB layout (vendor drawing): 2x round THT holes, 5.08mm pitch, single row; drill diameter 1.50mm (diagonal-leader callout - the only hole-size figure given; no separate pad/annular diameter stated).
Pin (solder tail) protrudes 4.50mm below the board seating plane - figure repeats consistently across the front, side, and PCB-layout views. Through-hole, wave/hand solder part.
Max soldering temperature +250C for 5 sec - a wave/hand-solder limit, not a reflow profile; sequence this part off any reflow pass if the rest of the board reflows.
Screw torque spec 4.08 kgf.cm / 0.4 N.m and wire strip length 6-7mm - wire-installation specs for assembly/test, not layout constraints.

Body footprint/clearance for placement: length (N x 5.08mm) 10.16mm for this 2-pole part, depth 10.00mm, height above PCB 14.07mm. The board's own height cap was dropped per H1-b (parts.json role note), so this height is recorded for the design doc only, not enforced as a constraint.
Non-polarized, mechanically symmetric part - no silkscreen polarity marking is defined by the datasheet; pin 1/2 to net-function assignment is a schematic-level convention only.
